2. 角色 B：厉燃（魔主）
五官特写： 瞳孔微红，嘴角有一抹轻佻的弧度，眉峰锐利如刀。

服饰外观： 玄色与暗红撞色的修身长袍。内衬是贴身黑绸，外罩一层赤色薄烟罗。领口微微敞开，露出清晰的锁骨。

配饰： 手腕缠绕着细碎的银色链条，腰间悬挂一只雕花漆红酒壶。黑发不扎不束，透着野性。
High quality, high grade, rich details, clear text, high-definition picture quality, light and shadow fusion.

Upgrade to 8K+ ultra-high-definition commercial-grade rendering, with 4x resolution enhancement (super-resolution) to refine micro-details (e.g., fabric textures, skin pores, hair strands, subtle folds).
Add professional soft studio lighting setups: key light (soft diffused main light to define contours), fill light (low-intensity to reduce harsh shadows), and rim light (subtle backlight to separate the subject from the background), ensuring natural light transitions and three-dimensionality.
Boost surface detail clarity: sharpen texture edges (without over-sharpening artifacts), enhance subtle material textures (e.g., fabric weave, leather luster, skin texture), and restore fine details lost in the original image.
Adjust color grading to maintain natural saturation: calibrate color temperature to match the scene’s tone, balance contrast and brightness for a polished yet realistic look, and retain the original color palette without oversaturation.

Ultra-high-definition professional photograph, 8K resolution, hyper-detailed textures, crystal-clear sharpness, lifelike details, cinematic clarity, studio-grade image quality, fine-grained rendering, no blurring or distortion
